headline: US-Iran War: Stock Market Direction Will Be Decided Next Week | US-Iran war: Stock market movements will be decided next week
summary: Indian markets face a important week as crude oil, US-Iran war developments, auto sales, fiscal deficit, PMI and industrial data are due. The outlook is expected to be driven by these factors.
why: The BSE Sensex is the benchmark index of India's largest listed companies, and oil prices and geopolitical risk are key drivers of Indian equities.
